title: Extraction of an L²-convergent subsequence from finite L²-nets
statement: Let (α, μ) be a measure space (α : Type with a measurable space structure, μ any measure on it) and let f_j : α → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ) be in L²(μ) (MemLp (f j) 2 μ). Suppose that for every η > 0 there is a finite S ⊆ ℕ such that every j has some k ∈ S with ∫ (f_j − f_k)² dμ ≤ η. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and W : α → ℝ with W ∈ L²(μ) and ∫ (f_{φ(j)} − W)² dμ → 0 as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (α : Type) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (f : ℕ → α → ℝ), (∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 μ) → (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ j, ∃ k ∈ S, ∫ x, (f j x - f k x) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ η) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (W : α → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ MemLp W 2 μ ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, (f (φ j) x - W x) ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
